review.why: Chooses how to make marketing video (code, AI generation, avatars, editing) and covers prompts, workflows for demos and clips, and repeatable pipelines.
review.summary: Compares four approaches: programmatic video with HTML or React frameworks, AI generation models, AI avatars and editing tools. It gives prompt basics, workflows for demos, explainers, batch clips and per-account videos, an agent-driven pipeline, common mistakes and a tool table. Prompting, demo recording and code-rendered film guides are in other files.
strengths: Picks the approach by team skills and source material, not by hype
Warns that AI models cannot reliably render readable text
Per-account video workflow with a QA step and consent for cloned voices
cautions: Model names, limits and prices change faster than the skill
Four reference files are not read here
Needs paid tools and API keys for most approaches
